svg.title: Red with White Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-recent-painting-and-sculpture-05-2003/lightbox/works/red-with-white-relief-2002-18628; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
